description: This file manages session transcript files, including resolving, archiving, classifying, and cleaning up session transcript files within a session management system.

methods.name: classifySessionTranscriptCandidate
methods.description: Classifies a session transcript file as 'current', 'stale', or 'custom' based on session ID and filename.

methods.name: extractGeneratedTranscriptSessionId
methods.description: Extracts a session ID from a filename if it matches expected patterns.

methods.name: looksLikeGeneratedSessionId
methods.description: Checks if a string matches the pattern of a UUID v4-like session ID.

methods.name: canonicalizePathForComparison
methods.description: Resolves a file path to its real path for comparison purposes.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptCandidates
methods.description: Resolves possible session transcript file paths based on session ID, store path, session file, and agent ID.

methods.name: archiveFileOnDisk
methods.description: Archives a file by renaming it with a timestamp and reason.

methods.name: archiveSessionTranscripts
methods.description: Archives session transcripts based on provided options, returning archived paths.

methods.name: archiveSessionTranscriptsDetailed
methods.description: Provides detailed info on archived session transcripts, including source and archived paths.

methods.name: resolveStableSessionEndTranscript
methods.description: Resolves the final session transcript file for a session, preferring archived or existing files.

methods.name: cleanupArchivedSessionTranscripts
methods.description: Removes archived session transcripts older than a specified age from given directories.
